digest.component_or_area: store write lock / mkdir lock reclamation
propositions: On platforms without /proc (macOS), _process_start_time returns None, making the recycled-pid discriminant unsatisfiable and leaving dead processes with recycled pids judged as fresh indefinitely

A dead lock holder whose pid number was reused by an unrelated live process causes unbounded lock wedging because the live-pid branch has no fallback when current_start is unavailable to prove liveness

The fix applies the 1h ceiling check to the live-pid branch only when current_start is None (unqualified verdict), while preserving no-timer-based reclamation for corroborated live owners whose start times match

The module size limit (800 LOC) requires splitting lock.py by extracting owner-identity/stamp/staleness/reclaim logic to lock_owner.py, with lock.py importing those symbols module-qualified to avoid creating duplicate bindings that defeat monkeypatching
